row.title: READ-BUDGET-5 last-known data
row.body: Evidence: the free daily D1 read allowance ran out at about 616000 rows per hour and /ops returned 503. d1QueriesAdaptiveGroups still ranked the dispatches status counts, the latest-dispatch-per-role join and the roles summary at 210k to 262k rows each over 3 h. site/controlplane.js now reads through an isolate map, a 120 s edge cache and a 7 day last-known copy served when the database refuses; site tests pass 17 of 17.
